about.title: What is Kuuki?
about.meaning: In Japan, "Kuuki wo yomu" (reading the air) means understanding the context without words.
about.meaningDetail: Kuuki "feels" your journeys, turning dry data into a beautiful flight history.

import.title: Smart Import (AI Import)
import.description: Don't type manually. Just drop a ticket screenshot, PDF, or email text. AI extracts flight, airline, and aircraft data. It's the **laziest** way to keep a flight log.

passport.title: Digital Impressions (Passport & Stats)
passport.description: Unique stamps for every country and detailed stats (from aircraft types to moon progress). It's not just a list, but your **progress as a world explorer**.

gamification.title: Stress-free Gamification
gamification.description: Badges for achievements (like "Night Owl" or "Equator Hopper") and percentile leaderboards. No pressure. You're always in the "top 15%", never at "145th place".

privacy.title: Privacy by Design
privacy.description: Share your public profile, but **your exact routes and map are always hidden**. Only stats and badges are visible. You choose what to share.

community.title: Community Driven
community.description: Built for a small circle (50-500 aviation enthusiasts). Suggest features boldly. Direct feedback shapes the final product.
